# SPIR-V headers

The five C headers of Khronos' SPIRV-Headers that the shader recompiler and the host shaders
include, and its license, copied unchanged from
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers at commit 2acb319af38d43be3ea76bfabf3998e5281d8d12.

To move them on, copy the same files from a newer commit over these:
`include/spirv/unified1/` spirv.h, GLSL.std.450.h, AMD_gcn_shader.h,
AMD_shader_explicit_vertex_parameter.h and AMD_shader_trinary_minmax.h.
